name: talkto-hooks
description: Tells your Codex agent when TalkTo messages arrive: at the end of each turn, and mid-turn for urgent direct messages. Reads a content-free signal link the agent creates through its own TalkTo MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Hear about TalkTo messages at each turn end
interface.longDescription: Tells your Codex agent when TalkTo messages arrive: at the end of each turn, and mid-turn for urgent direct messages. The agent reads them with get_updates through its own TalkTo MCP connection. The hooks hold no credential and never read message text.
